summary.text: Wolf Enslavement Gu is an expendable enslavement Gu used to subdue wolves. Rank decides which wolf kings it can take, and the Gu disperses after use whether the attempt succeeds or fails.

claims.text: Fang Yuan holds both rank two and rank three wolf enslavement Gu while preparing to operate as Chang Shan Yin. Wolf enslavement Gu at rank three can enslave a thousand wolf king. Wolf enslavement Gu at rank four can enslave a myriad wolf king or mutated beasts.

Beast enslavement Gu at rank four can control myriad beast kings, and controlling through a wolf king eases the soul burden of commanding the group. Beast enslavement Gu at rank four is normally not sold in northern plains markets; Fang Yuan buys only rank two and rank three until a rank four wolf enslavement Gu is found in a myriad wolf king’s corpse and given to him.
Fang Yuan mentions having a rank four wolf enslavement Gu with him.
Large numbers of wolf enslavement Gu reside at the bottom of Fang Yuan’s primeval sea. He has many rank two, few rank three, and no rank four stored inside.

Large numbers of wolf enslavement Gu remain at the bottom of Fang Yuan’s primeval sea throughout his later operations in northern plains. When Tu Bo lacks sufficient rank to activate a rank four wolf enslavement Gu, Fang Yuan orders him to use it anyway; Tu Bo must pour primeval essence into it for a long time before the Gu slowly activates, turning into mystical light that descends on a shark fin wolf’s body while flickering.

Wolf enslavement Gu is a one time expendable Gu. To capture so many wolf kings, Fang Yuan has used up large amounts of it. Generally speaking, wolf kings would have corresponding wolf enslavement Gu on them, which Fang Yuan collects from defeated wolf kings.
Fang Yuan requires destroying a wolf king’s defensive Gu before wolf enslavement Gu can work on it, as golden bell shield Gu and similar defenses would prevent the smoke from taking effect.

Fang Yuan lacks the recipe for wolf enslavement Gu. He buys the recipe for rank one to three wolf enslavement Gu from a Gu refinement shop; the recipe for rank four is held in the hands of the few large tribes and rarely seen in the market. Later, he negotiates with a shopkeeper and buys five rank three wolf enslavement Gu and thirty-eight rank two wolf enslavement Gu in a single transaction.

Fang Yuan obtains rank one to rank five wolf enslavement Gu recipes from Lang Ya land spirit. At every rank there are different recipe types; there are eight types of recipes just for rank five wolf enslavement Gu alone, each using different materials and different procedures to obtain similar Gu worms, with even more types for rank one to rank four wolf enslavement Gu recipes.

For mass refining wolf enslavement Gu, Fang Yuan needs large numbers of hairy men to help with the work; without them and only using Little Hu Immortal’s labor, the refinement would take two to three months.
A rank two wolf enslavement Gu turns into a lump of blue smoke and descends to enshroud a hundred beast wolf king.

Fang Yuan later obtains another rank two wolf enslavement Gu from a female hump wolf’s den. When thrown, it explodes into light smoke that covers the target and merges into the body, after which the hump wolf shows submission.
Almost all beast enslavement Gu are expendable. After use, success or failure, they disperse.
Fang Yuan uses wolf enslavement Gu to turn a hundred wolf king’s alignment during battle, causing it to howl and rally other wolves to join him.

When activating wolf enslavement Gu, Fang Yuan uses a rank two wolf enslavement Gu that turns into light smoke to land on a hundred wolf king’s body. A wolf king with a firelight Gu can shoot out flame that burns the smoke away before it lands. Fang Yuan uses rank three wolf enslavement Gu, which turns into light smoke much thicker than the rank two version, to subdue a thousand wolf king; the thicker smoke succeeded and completely fused into the thousand wolf king’s soul after a dozen breaths’ time. Using wolf enslavement Gu puts significant burden on the soul, not primeval essence; after subduing multiple hundred wolf kings with his hundred man soul, Fang Yuan experiences annoyed feelings and impulsiveness that could lead to dizziness or soul damage.

Fang Yuan uses rank four wolf enslavement Gu to subdue a night wolf king after its battle intent disappears and it sustains heavy injuries; the Gu turns into a large cloud of smoke that covers the night wolf king’s head.
Fang Yuan uses wolf enslavement Gu to subdue more than two thousand water wolves during a battle.

Fang Yuan approaches a wild myriad wolf king at the opportune time and uses rank four wolf enslavement Gu to subdue it, requiring only the lives of a few hundred night wolves to take in this myriad wolf king and close to twenty thousand wolves under it.
In the final wolf tide conflict of Fang Yuan’s northern plains career, the opposing enslavement path Gu worms are much more comprehensive and superior to his wolf enslavement Gu worms.
